name: cc-translate
description: Type to Claude Code in Chinese, Japanese, Korean or Russian: prompts reach Claude in English, replies are shown in your language

enabled.title: Enable translation
enabled.description: Default on/off; /translate on|off overrides it and is remembered

base_url.title: Translator base URL
base_url.description: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (the part before /chat/completions), e.g. https://api.deepseek.com or https://api.openai.com/v1

model.title: Translator model
model.description: Model name at that endpoint; a small fast model is enough

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Key for the translator endpoint; left empty, the CC_TRANSLATE_API_KEY environment variable is used

extra_body.title: Extra request fields (JSON)
extra_body.description: A JSON object merged into every request body. The default turns DeepSeek's thinking off; set it to {} for providers that refuse unknown fields

lang.title: Your language
lang.description: The language you type in and read replies in; the plugin's own messages use it too
